default.notes: Apply for a visa in advance at a Malian embassy — there is no functioning e-visa or tourist visa on arrival, and most Western governments advise against travel to large parts of Mali.

groups.notes: Burkina Faso and Niger form the Alliance of Sahel States confederation with Mali — citizens of the three countries move freely between them.

ECOWAS citizens have continued to enter Mali visa-free under transitional free-movement arrangements despite Mali's January 2025 withdrawal from the bloc — re-confirm shortly before travel as this may change.
Visa-free under a bilateral agreement, generally for up to 90 days — confirm the current terms with a Malian embassy before travel.

ML.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Malian citizens.
